name: JPY Coin
oneLiner: JPYC is JPYC Inc.'s centralized yen stablecoin, backed 1:1 by JPY deposits and Japanese government bonds under a Type II Funds Transfer Service license.
collateral: Japanese yen deposits and Japanese government bonds (100% backed)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for JPY through JPYC Inc. via the JPYC EX platform; issuance and redemption via bank transfer after KYC; JPYC Inc. holds a Type II Funds Transfer Service Provider license under Japan's Payment Services Act

jurisdiction.license: Type II Funds Transfer Service Provider (Payment Services Act)

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: JPYC resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: JPYC is a centralized mintable ERC-20. The current regulated Ethereum token uses a FiatToken-style proxy implementation with role-managed minting; RPC reads resolve the token owner Safe, minterAdmin contract, and minterAdmin owner Safe.

controls.label: JPYC regulated Ethereum proxy mint surface
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 implementation read returned 0xafac17fc3936a29ca2d2787ced3c5d1c52007d2e at Ethereum block 25201628; verified source exposes onlyMinters mint plus minterAdmin-gated configureMinter/removeMinter/minterAllowance.

controls.label: JPYC minterAdmin contract
controls.evidence: minterAdmin() returned this contract at Ethereum block 25201628; owner() on the minterAdmin returned 0x5BA1b9aAf56Af1B761519F924079681D8d061F94, but the minterAdmin contract source was not verified by Sourcify.

controls.label: JPYC minterAdmin owner Safe
controls.evidence: minterAdmin.owner() returned this Safe at Ethereum block 25201628. Safe API returned threshold 2, three owners, no modules, and zero guard.

controls.label: JPYC token owner Safe
controls.evidence: owner() returned this Safe at Ethereum block 25201628; verified source gates updateMinterAdmin and UUPS upgrades behind onlyOwner. Safe API returned threshold 3, five owners, no modules, and zero guard.

review.evidence: Ethereum RPC reads for the current regulated token identify the role-gated mint implementation, minterAdmin contract, token owner Safe, and minterAdmin owner Safe.
